titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦昭襄王五十六年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 251 BC: the entry of the Basic Annals of Qin under the fifty-sixth year of King Zhaoxiang, the year of his death.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Zhao, Chu and Yan.

The entries of the Hereditary Houses for this year: the houses of Yan and Zhao on Yan's attack on Zhao and its defeat at Hao and Dai, and the houses of Chu, Wei and Han on the death of King Zhao of Qin.

The Biographies for this year: the Biography of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing, excerpted from the beginning to Lord Pingyuan's death in this year, and the lines of the Biography of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru on the defeat of Yan and Lian Po's enfeoffment.
The lines of the Biography of Lü Buwei on the death of King Zhao of Qin and the return of Zichu's wife and son from Zhao.
